### POST /api/document/{org}/{db}/{repo}/branch/{branch}

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/README.md

Inserts a new document into a specific branch of a database.

```APIDOC
## POST /api/document/{org}/{db}/{repo}/branch/{branch}

### Description
Inserts a document into the specified database branch.

### Method
POST

### Endpoint
/api/document/{org}/{db}/{repo}/branch/{branch}

### Parameters
#### Path Parameters
- **org** (string) - Required - The organization name
- **db** (string) - Required - The database name
- **repo** (string) - Required - The repository name
- **branch** (string) - Required - The branch name

### Request Example
{
  "@type": "Person",
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": 30
}
```

--------------------------------

### Insert Documents

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/README.md

HTTP POST request to add a JSON-LD document to a specific branch.

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:6363/api/document/my-org/my-database/local/branch/main \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46U2VjdXJlUGFzc3dvcmQxMjMh" \
  -d '{
    "@type": "Person",
    "name": "Alice",
    "age": 30
  }'
```

### branch_create

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/branches-and-history.md

Creates a new branch in a repository. Supports starting from main, a specific commit, or an empty state.

```APIDOC
## branch_create

### Description
Creates a new branch in a repository. Validates that the branch name is not in use and initializes the branch with schema and prefixes.

### Signature
branch_create(+Repository_Descriptor, +Auth, +New_Branch_Name, -Branch_Uri)

### Parameters
- **Repository_Descriptor** (repository_descriptor) - Required - Repository context
- **Auth** (auth_object) - Required - Authentication object
- **New_Branch_Name** (atom/string) - Required - Name for new branch
- **Branch_Uri** (atom) - Out - URI identifier for new branch

### Return Value
- Success: Branch_Uri unified with new branch identifier
- Throws: branch_already_exists, invalid_branch_name

### Example
branch_create(
  repository_descriptor{
    database_descriptor: database_descriptor{
      organization_name: 'my-org',
      database_name: 'my-db'
    },
    repository_name: 'local'
  },
  auth_object{user_name: alice},
  'feature-x',
  Branch_Uri
)
```

--------------------------------

### api_insert_documents

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/documents.md

Inserts one or more JSON documents into a database graph using a specified input stream and configuration options.

```APIDOC
## api_insert_documents

### Description
Inserts one or more JSON documents into a database graph. This operation supports optimistic locking via data versions and allows configuration of commit metadata and graph targeting.

### Signature
api_insert_documents(+System_DB, +Auth, +Path, +Stream, +Requested_Data_Version, -New_Data_Version, -Ids, +Options)

### Parameters
- **System_DB** (system_descriptor) - Required - System database descriptor
- **Auth** (auth_object) - Required - Authentication object
- **Path** (string) - Required - Database path (e.g., "org/database/local/branch/main")
- **Stream** (stream) - Required - Input stream of JSON documents
- **Requested_Data_Version** (integer) - Optional - Expected data version (for optimistic locking)
- **New_Data_Version** (integer) - Out - Data version after insertion
- **Ids** (list) - Out - List of generated/assigned document IDs
- **Options** (dict) - Required - Configuration options including graph_type, author, message, and input_format

### Options Dictionary
- **graph_type** (atom) - Default: instance - Graph to target: 'instance' or 'schema'
- **author** (string) - Default: "REST API" - Commit author name
- **message** (string) - Optional - Commit message
- **full_replace** (boolean) - Default: false - Replace entire graph instead of merge
- **raw_json** (boolean) - Default: false - Skip JSON-LD processing
- **input_format** (atom) - Default: json - Input format: 'json', 'jsonld', 'turtle'

### Example
```prolog
Stream = stream(json_documents),
api_insert_documents(
  System_DB,
  auth_object{user_name: alice},
  'my-org/my-database/local/branch/main',
  Stream,
  _,
  New_Version,
  Ids,
  _{graph_type: instance, author: 'Alice User', message: 'Adding new person records', input_format: json}
)
```

### POST /api/branch/:path/:branch

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/branches-and-history.md

Creates a new branch in the specified repository path.

```APIDOC
## POST /api/branch/:path/:branch

### Description
Creates a new branch.

### Method
POST

### Endpoint
/api/branch/:path/:branch

### Request Body
- **origin** (string) - Optional - Source branch (default: "main")
- **empty.schema** (boolean) - Optional - Include schema in new branch
- **empty.prefixes** (object) - Optional - Initial prefixes

### Response
#### Success Response (200/201)
- **api:branch_uri** (string) - URI of the created branch
- **api:status** (string) - Status of the operation

#### Response Example
{
  "@type": "api:BranchCreateResponse",
  "api:branch_uri": "terminusdb:///data/my-org/my-db/local/branch/feature-x",
  "api:status": "api:success"
}
```

### clone

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/advanced-operations.md

Creates a complete, independent copy of a database including its entire commit history and data.

```APIDOC
## clone

### Description
Creates a complete copy of a database, including all branches, commits, and data. The resulting database has its own independent storage.

### Signature
clone(+System_DB, +Auth, +Source_Organization, +Source_Database, +Target_Organization, +Target_Database, +Label, +Comment, +Schema, +Public, -Target_Db_Uri)

### Parameters
- **System_DB** (system_descriptor) - Required - System database descriptor
- **Auth** (auth_object) - Required - Authentication object
- **Source_Organization** (atom) - Required - Source org name
- **Source_Database** (atom) - Required - Source database name
- **Target_Organization** (atom) - Required - Target org name
- **Target_Database** (atom) - Required - Target database name
- **Label** (string) - Required - Human-readable label
- **Comment** (string) - Optional - Description
- **Schema** (boolean) - Optional - Copy schema
- **Public** (boolean) - Optional - Make public
- **Target_Db_Uri** (atom) - Output - New database URI

### Return Value
- Success: Target_Db_Uri unified with new database
- Throws: database_already_exists, permission_denied

### Example
clone(System_DB, admin_auth{user_name: admin}, 'source-org', 'source-db', 'target-org', 'cloned-db', 'Clone of Source DB', 'Testing clone functionality', true, Target_Uri)
```

### api_squash

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/advanced-operations.md

Squashes multiple commits into a single commit to simplify branch history.

```APIDOC
## api_squash

### Description
Squashes multiple commits into a single commit. This is useful for cleaning up feature branches or simplifying verbose commit logs.

### Parameters
- **System_DB** (system_descriptor) - Required - System database descriptor
- **Auth** (auth_object) - Required - Authentication object
- **Path** (string) - Required - Branch path
- **Requested_Data_Version** (integer) - Optional - Expected version (optimistic lock)
- **New_Data_Version** (integer) - Out - Version after squash
- **Options** (dict) - Optional - Operation options

### Example
api_squash(
  System_DB,
  user_auth{user_name: alice},
  'org/db/local/branch/feature-x',
  _,
  New_Version,
  _{commit_info: commit_info{author: 'Alice', message: 'Feature X implementation'}}
)
```

### api_reset

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/_autodocs/api-reference/advanced-operations.md

Resets a branch to a previous commit, effectively moving the branch HEAD.

```APIDOC
## api_reset

### Description
Resets branch to a previous commit. Note that the current implementation performs a hard reset, which discards all changes.

### Parameters
- **System_DB** (system_descriptor) - Required - System database descriptor
- **Auth** (auth_object) - Required - Authentication object
- **Path** (string) - Required - Branch path
- **Target_Commit** (atom) - Required - Commit ID or ref to reset to

### Example
api_reset(
  System_DB,
  user_auth{user_name: alice},
  'org/db/local/branch/main',
  'abc123def456'
)
```

### Initialize Database and Insert Data via CLI

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/GETTING_STARTED.md

Create a new database, define a schema, and insert a document using the TerminusDB command line interface.

```shell
# Create a new database
terminusdb db create admin/example1

# Add a schema (define your data structure)
terminusdb doc insert --graph_type=schema admin/example1 <<EOF
{ "@id" : "Person",
  "@type" : "Class",
  "name" : "xsd:string",
  "occupation" : "xsd:string",
  "friends" : { "@type" : "Set",
                "@class" : "Person" }}
EOF

# Insert data
terminusdb doc insert admin/example1 --message='adding Gavin' <<EOF
{ "@type" : "Person","name" : "Gavin", "occupation" : "Coder"}
EOF
```

### Insert and Retrieve High-Precision Decimals

Source: https://github.com/terminusdb/terminusdb/blob/main/docs/ARBITRARY_PRECISION_DECIMALS_ARCHITECTURE.md

Shows how the Document API maintains precision for large decimal values during insertion and retrieval.

```javascript
// Insert high-precision decimal
await client.insertDocument({
  "@type": "Payment",
  "amount": "123456789.123456789012345678"  // 27 digits
});

// Retrieve - precision maintained
const doc = await client.getDocument("Payment/...");
console.log(doc.amount);  // 123456789.12345678901234568 (20 digit precision)
```
